build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places a dynamic ball and static bars in a physics scene
create_static_bar: create a static bar object with configurable angle, position, and dimensions using C.add
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object with configurable radius and position using C.add
update_task_relationship: update the task to require a TOUCHING spatial relationship between two bodies
skip_invalid_params: skip invalid template parameter combinations by raising creator_lib.SkipTemplateParams
